summary.name: Mercor
summary.one_liner: Mercor is a platform that sources human experts (physicians, lawyers, engineers, consultants) to build AI benchmarks, evaluations, and RL environments for AI labs and enterprises.
use_cases: Sourcing expert contractors for AI evaluation
Training and testing AI agents on professional tasks
Turning enterprise workflow data into AI training revenue
Deploying production AI with embedded engineers
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Mercor as a provider of human expert work for AI: contracted experts, benchmarks, and RL environments. It lists benchmark categories (legal, accounting, software, banking) with leaderboard-style scores for named AI models, such as a legal benchmark of 1,749 tasks across 24 practice areas and a banking support benchmark over 700 policy documents. For enterprises, it describes mapping workflows, building evaluations, and selling workflow data, with automated anonymization that masks 60+ categories of sensitive identifiers. The page states an average contracted expert rate of $96/hr, 655k roles created, and $4M+ daily payouts.
notable: Expert network of 5M+ professionals used for AI evaluation
Benchmarks co-built with partners such as Sierra AI and Cognition, including open-source legal and banking benchmarks
Automated anonymization masking 60+ categories of sensitive identifiers for enterprise data
Leaderboard-style scores with confidence intervals across frontier models
caveats: Pricing for enterprise services is not stated on the page
Benchmark scores are snapshots from the page and may change; confidence intervals are wide on some tasks
Enterprise offerings are described in general terms without concrete pricing or plan details
